name: Bonny International Holding Limited
summary: Bonny International Holding Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of intimate wear products. It operates in two segments, Original Design Manufacture (ODM) Products and Brand Products. The ODM Products segment manufactures and sells seamless underwear or other ODM products to overseas customers or their agents. The Brand Products segment manufactures and sells ladies brassieres, panties, thermal underwear, under the Bonny and U+Bonny brand names.
